title: Forward+/Mobile: Framerate is capped during fast mouse motion on macOS, even with V-Sync disabled
body:
### Tested versions

Reproduced on 4.5-dev2 and latest master (1696ab0c)

### System information

macOS Sequoia (15.4.0) - Multi-window, 2 monitors (1920x1080@75hz and 3456x2234@120hz) - Metal (Mobile) - integrated Apple M1 Max (Apple7) - Apple M1 Max (10 threads)

### Issue description

Initially, when VSync is disabled, the framerate seems to be uncapped (>300fps) as expected.

However, if the window is on the 75hz monitor, as soon as the mouse is moved, the frame rate inexplicably locks to 150fps.

The framerate always works as expected whenever the window is on the 120hz monitor.

Here is a screen recording of the behavior:
https://www.swisstransfer.com/d/aa53d61e-c5c2-4d64-88b1-e478b9de1181
(Apologies for the link, GitHub file upload doesn't seem to be working for me right now. Please re-upload it in the comments if you are able.)

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create new project
2. Set `display/window/vsync/vsync_mode` to `Disabled`
3. In Debugger panel → Monitors tab, enable FPS monitor
4. Run an empty scene, ensuring it opens on the 75hz monitor
5. Do not move the mouse; observe uncapped frame rate
6. Move the mouse; observe 150fps frame rate

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Here is an MRP that provides a VSync toggle and FPS display for convenience.
It is the project I used to record the screen capture.
